title: UK Data API
description: 24 UK data endpoints — property, weather, companies, vehicles, finance. Paid via x402.
summary: 24 UK data endpoints — property, weather, companies, vehicles, finance. Paid via x402.

toolsPreview.name: get_sold_prices
toolsPreview.description: HM Land Registry sold prices for a UK postcode. Returns address, price paid, date, property type, tenure. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_yield_estimate
toolsPreview.description: Rental yield estimates for a UK postcode area. Returns average rents, gross/net yields, price-to-rent ratios. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: calculate_stamp_duty
toolsPreview.description: UK Stamp Duty Land Tax calculator. Supports first-time buyer relief, additional property surcharge, non-UK resident surcharge. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_epc_rating
toolsPreview.description: Energy Performance Certificate ratings for properties near a UK postcode. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_crime_stats
toolsPreview.description: Police-recorded crime statistics for a UK postcode area. Returns crime categories, counts, trends. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_flood_risk
toolsPreview.description: Flood risk assessment for a UK postcode. Returns risk levels for rivers, seas, surface water, reservoirs. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_planning_applications
toolsPreview.description: Planning applications near a UK postcode. Returns application details, status, decisions. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_council_tax
toolsPreview.description: Council tax band and rates for a UK postcode area. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_current_weather
toolsPreview.description: Current weather conditions for a UK location. Temperature, humidity, wind, conditions. [x402: $0.001/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_weather_forecast

toolsPreview.name: get_historical_weather
toolsPreview.description: Historical weather data for a UK location. Past temperature, rainfall, sunshine hours. [x402: $0.002/call]

toolsPreview.name: get_air_quality

toolsPreview.name: search_companies

toolsPreview.name: get_company_profile

toolsPreview.name: get_company_officers

toolsPreview.name: get_company_filings

toolsPreview.name: get_vehicle_info

toolsPreview.name: get_vehicle_emissions
